note: Answer key, written before any outcome. 'expected' is the behaviour the FROZEN CONTRACT (PREREGISTRATION s5-s7, RULER.md, ERASE_PROBES.md, CLOSURE.md P-FLAT, evaluate.py's own docstring) calls for; 'prediction' is what I think the frozen code will do. A case scores AS_EXPECTED when the observation matches 'expected', SURVIVOR when a broken case is admitted or a sound case refused, PREMISE_FAILED when the fixture itself does not hold (then the case is void and reported as such). Numeric outcomes of registered-arm constructions are redacted from the rows; scoring never needs them.

W1.B8.NULL_ARM_IS_NOT_NO_CARRY.setup: The POS carrier (plastic) under arm NULL vs arm S on 8 synthetic seeds: is W1 written during an episode under reset_each_step; do the NULL arm's actions differ from S's at all, and after the last interrupt. S-NOPL as the comparison ablation.
W1.B8.NULL_ARM_IS_NOT_NO_CARRY.prediction: SURVIVOR: reset_each_step zeroes activations only (substrate.Runtime.step), plasticity still writes W1 and the carrier re-derives h from inputs every step, so NULL(POS) == S(POS) action for action (0 differing) while S-NOPL(POS) differs. The NULL arm removes the activation channel, not the plastic one: for a subject that retains through plastic W1 the NULL arm retains too, P-CAL FAILS, and the campaign is DETECTION_UNQUALIFIED exactly when the subject carries by the allowed channel.
W1.B8.NULL_ARM_IS_NOT_NO_CARRY.scoring: AS_EXPECTED iff NULL(POS) differs from S(POS) after the last interrupt; SURVIVOR iff 0 differing actions (and W1 written).
